question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A person who likes or admires women
solution:
The correct answer is "**Philogynist**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given question, the word "philogynist" is the most appropriate word for the given phrase.**

 
 
• **Philogynist is a noun that means a person who likes or admires women.**(स्‍त्रीप्रेमी)

 
 
• ​Example: His work in some sections is philogynist, while in other parts he writes misogynist satires.
 
 
 
 
 
• The word is derived from the Greek words 'philos' meaning love and 'gune' meaning woman.
 
• The opposite of a philogynist is a misogynist, which means a person who hates or dislikes women.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Misogynist (Option 1) means a person who hates or dislikes women.(नारी द्वेषी)
 
• Conversationalist (Option 3) means a person who enjoys or is skilled at conversation.(बातूनी)
 
• Polyglot (Option 4) means a person who knows and is able to use several languages.(बहुभाषी)
